caption: Not every financial institution is built the same. Raviv sat down with the team at Light House Credit Union; a credit union run by and for the local Jewish community. To the Jewish Community, They understand your needs. Your circumstances. Your situation. That’s not something you usually get at a big bank. When your financial institution actually knows your community; everything changes.
short: A credit union run by and for the local Jewish community.

caption: “Transforming women and making them feel confident and beautiful is my favorite thing.” We sat down with Chavi, the amazing founder and owner of House of Hair Extensions, to talk about her 5-year entrepreneurial journey. From navigating the transition of working from home as a single mom to running her own gorgeous salon, Chavi’s story is a masterclass in dedication and passion. 💇‍♀️ In this interview, she opens up about: ✨ Finding her “why” in her daughter ✨ Building a client base that feels like family ✨ Being a female founder in the beauty industry ✨ Her biggest advice for aspiring entrepreneurs: “Just start somewhere. Just do it.” We are also beyond honored to be a part of her growth story—thank you, Chavi, for naming Talkerstein Consulting Group as your best marketing decision! 😉📈 Watch the full interview to get inspired. If you’re ready for a flawless hair transformation and unmatched confidence, look no further! 👇 🔗 Discover your perfect match at: www.houseofhairextensionz.ca 📲 Follow the magic on IG & TikTok: @houseofhairextensionz
short: From working at home as a single mom to her own salon.

caption: Had the privilege of sitting down with Tova founder of Fringe Boutique, a brand redefining modern modest fashion. We spoke about more than clothing. We spoke about values. About building confidence through design. About creating pieces that reflect values without compromising style. Strong brands don’t just sell products they stand for something. Excited for what’s ahead.
short: Modern modest fashion, built on values and confidence.

caption: I had the privilege of interviewing Mark Halpern, founder of WEALTHinsurance.com, to discuss his journey building one of Canada’s leading wealth insurance advisory firms. In our conversation, he shared a simple truth: Everyone wants success. Few want responsibility. The more responsibility he accepted, the more opportunity followed. Responsibility builds trust. Trust builds reputation. Reputation builds legacy. Success isn’t accidental. It’s earned by the weight you’re willing to carry. More conversations from the Bathurst street community coming soon
short: Building one of Canada’s leading wealth insurance firms.

caption: I had the privilege of sitting down with one of our dearest friends customer, and Influencer KeechenPapi A.K.A. Emanuel Yakobov owner of Kapara restaurant in Toronto, to unpack the real story behind his success. No shortcuts. No overnight wins. Just: Hard work. Faith. And the courage to take risks when others hesitate. These are the patterns I see in every successful entrepreneur. More conversations like this coming soon…
short: The real story behind Kapara: hard work, faith and risk.
